# Beware the False Plague: Scam Alert & Account Restoration
Greetings, Doctors.
The Asylum's walls protect many, but shadows still creep in. We've spotted a new threat spreading through our ranks. Read carefully, and share it with your fellow Doctors.

🕯️ I. Beware Social Media Scammers
Recently, scammers have been using Alliance Mail to invite Doctors to add their personal social media accounts (Discord or Telegram) as friends.
Once added, these fraudsters send private messages claiming the game is "shutting down soon" — a fabricated lie designed to:
Trick you into revealing personal information
Lure you into clicking scam / advertisement links
Do not trust private messages from unknown social accounts. The only source of truth is the official Last Asylum: Plague community. If you receive such a message, report it to Customer Service immediately.
📍 In-game path: Settings → Help → Customer Service

⚰️ II. Wrongfully Banned? We're Restoring Access
In our effort to purge the advertisement bots behind these scams, we banned a number of accounts. Unfortunately, some legitimate Doctors were caught in the purge and wrongfully banned.
If you were affected, here is how to recover your account:

1️⃣ Method 1 — Through the In-Game Popup (Fastest)
When the ban popup appears, click the "Help" button inside the prompt window to contact Customer Service directly. (See the customer service button in the attached screenshot.)
Our team will need time to verify your account information — please be patient while we investigate.

2️⃣ Method 2 — Google Form (Priority Queue for Wrongful Bans)
Wrongfully banned Doctors may also fill out this form, and we will prioritize your case:
🔗 https://forms.gle/wUZHvXUYLQzUC6i9A

🩻 Stay Vigilant, Doctors
The Asylum endures because of you. Keep your personal information safe, trust only official channels, and report anything suspicious. Together, we hold the line against the plague — and those who profit from it.

 The Last Asylum: Plague Team

@everyone
